patch_description: Key parameters of the current approach: fixed 30 greedy restarts with sample_rate=0.9 and 8 samples, followed by a full local search (swap + Or-opt). This ignores wall-clock budget — 30 restarts may underuse time. New configuration: (1) time-budgeted restart loop (~8s deadline per workload), alternating between fresh randomized greedy constructions and, every 3rd restart, a perturbed copy of the current best ("shuffled best": remove 4–6 random transactions, greedy reinsert each at its cheapest evaluated position). This keeps the cost-guided greedy signal while starting restarts near a proven-good solution. (2) Apply local search to each candidate before comparing, so improved solutions seed subsequent perturbations. (3) Cheaper perturbation restarts also free time for more local search passes on the incumbent.
